physical_subject: Why can moving a pluck change timbre without changing the string tuning?
relationship: Ideal triangular pluck modal coefficients include sin(n pi d/L), eliminating even modes at the midpoint and multiples of three at one third.
operation: Change the triangular starting displacement from midpoint to one third; show the corresponding missing modes and hear a synthetic six-mode mixture.
closest_prior: reasoning/05-waves: two-wave fixed nodes; old Fourier makes music title
substantive_difference: Initial triangular displacement selects modal amplitudes while frequencies remain fixed. Central operation is changing pluck location, not forming standing nodes or arbitrary Fourier sums. Earlier Fourier transcript unavailable.
